main_measure.name: OLS slope of 3-day excess return on forecast, forecast > 0 grid bars, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 on >= 100 cases; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2 on >= 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess per unit forecast, trending minus unknown

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: The normal drift is each coin's mean 3-day return over all grid bars of all its windows, the mean excess per unit of forecast is sum(excess)/sum(forecast) per regime, a regime is the record's regime on the case bar, and a supporting check that cannot be computed counts as not passed.
